title: Record discussion: the system line「Created 借阅记录 …」is English in a zh-CN console; the grid's `#` cell goes empty on the hovered or selected row
body:
## Source

Walked on 2026-10-16 on the test1016 tenant (zh-CN): a loan record's 讨论 shows the system line「Created 借阅记录 "月亮与六便士｜赵明轩｜借阅记录"」— English verb in a zh-CN console; in the 图书 list row 6 and in the loan list row 1 the `#` cell is empty while the other rows are numbered (the hovered / selected row loses its number to the checkbox).

## Target

1. The system discussion line is translated (「创建了 借阅记录 …」) with the record name in quotes; the key lives in every shipped locale.
2. The `#` cell shows the number until the row is selected; on hover the checkbox appears beside it, not instead of it.

## File surface

The discussion system-line i18n in `packages/plugin-detail` / `packages/i18n/src/locales/*`, `packages/plugin-grid/src` (the `#` cell), tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests per target; screenshots of a record's discussion and a hovered row in zh-CN.

## Evidence

Screenshots on the same branch and commit: [ai-runtime-loan-record-dialog.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23ef817aa/docs/design/ai-build-2026-10-16/ai-runtime-loan-record-dialog.jpg?raw=true) · [ai-runtime-books-21-records.jpg](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/blob/23ef817aa/docs/design/ai-build-2026-10-16/ai-runtime-books-21-records.jpg?raw=true).

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 build of a library-lending app (package `app.hcpl`: 图书 / 读者 / 借阅记录, a status kanban, an overdue view) on the test1016 tenant at https://os-4e4qa4.objectos.app (staging, zh-CN, the maintainer's browser pane at 1010 × 1119), through 用 AI 搭建 → the plan card → 开始搭建 → the Studio copilot → one change → the running app. The maintainer named the repositories, verbatim: 「ai 搭建的功能在 cloud仓库」「部分前端功能代码在 objectui 后端在 onjectstack」, and ruled on the design in chat: 「同意」 to the four points as drawn, then 「是否考虑浮出」/「属性好需要考虑选中每个元素的时候也要显示」, then 「按浮窗版定稿」.</sub>
